_meta.description: Every shape GET /files/current/media-info answers: all fields, a length with a format, a length alone, and an unknown file. Every field is optional and absent means unknown, so a client ignores keys it does not read and treats a missing key as unknown. Built by server/tests/media-info-fixtures.ts; server/tests/media-info-fixtures.test.ts fails when the committed bytes differ, and Apple MediaInfoContractTests decodes these examples.

examples.name: length only, as a header states no format
unknown, as an unparsed or malformed file answers
